_comment: UNMEASURED. Every pattern here is a hypothesis about a devops domain, not a finding. Measured against the three corpora this project does have -- 40 SWE-agent coding trajectories, 60 airline and 80 retail conversations -- these four patterns produced zero extractions, so none of them has been shown to fire and none has a measured precision. Treat it as a starting point to validate against your own transcripts, not as a tuned schema. It previously described itself as 'a schema for the corpus the benchmarks actually run on', which was false: no benchmark used it.

_measurement.note: Never measured. Matches nothing in any of the three corpora above (0 extractions across 100 transcripts). The patterns are hypotheses about a devops domain, not derived from one.
